globalContext.primaryTransmissionChannel: Mortgage Interest Rate Transmission to Household Disposable Cash Flow & Housing Secondary Inventory Velocity

activeAlerts.headline: 🔒 "Golden Handcuffs" Supply Freeze: +2.53% Rate Disconnect
activeAlerts.body: New 30Y mortgage originations (6.45%) exceed effective locked-in rates on outstanding debt (3.92%) by 2.53 percentage points. Existing homeowners cannot move without forfeiting low-rate debt, paralyzing housing inventory.

activeAlerts.headline: ✅ Affordability Normalized: HAI at 101.1
activeAlerts.body: Median household purchasing power is aligned with or exceeds conventional qualifying income thresholds for median-priced housing.

activeAlerts.headline: ⚡ Mortgage Basis Dislocation: 240 bps Spread over 10Y Treasury
activeAlerts.body: The spread between 30Y fixed mortgages and 10Y Treasuries (240 bps vs historical ~170 bps norm) remains elevated due to Fed MBS balance sheet runoff (QT) and prepayment volatility risk.

activeAlerts.headline: 📊 Real vs Nominal Divergence: Real Home Prices -1.1% vs Peak
activeAlerts.body: While nominal Case-Shiller sits near all-time records (336.5), deflating property by cumulative CPI inflation reveals real purchasing power has plateaued at 175.2.
